name: Leukoencephalopathy with Brainstem and Spinal Cord Involvement and Lactate Elevation
aliases: Leukoencephalopathy with Brainstem and Spinal Cord Involvement

criteria.description: Progressive spasticity, ataxia, and peripheral neuropathy
Characteristic MRI findings showing leukoencephalopathy with involvement of brainstem and spinal cord tracts
Elevated lactate levels in brain MR spectroscopy or cerebrospinal fluid
Pathogenic mutations in the DARS2 gene confirmed by molecular genetic testing

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of clinical features plus characteristic MRI findings and confirmation by genetic testing
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Lactate elevation supports diagnosis but is not mandatory.

laboratory: Elevated lactate in cerebrospinal fluid or brain MR spectroscopy
imaging: MRI showing diffuse leukoencephalopathy with selective involvement of brainstem and spinal cord tracts, particularly dorsal columns and corticospinal tracts
genetic: Biallelic pathogenic variants in DARS2 gene

redFlags: Early onset with failure to thrive
references: Van der Knaap MS, et al. Leukoencephalopathy with brainstem and spinal cord involvement and lactate elevation (LBSL): clinical and radiologic features. Neurology. 2003.
Scheper GC, et al. Mutations in DARS2 cause leukoencephalopathy with brainstem and spinal cord involvement and lactate elevation. Nat Genet. 2007.
Orphanet: Leukoencephalopathy with brainstem and spinal cord involvement and lactate elevation (LBSL).
